energy_allowance.note: Home energy only (heating, hot water, cooking, appliances). Essential travel is covered by free public transport for needs and a mobility allowance set by the Scientific Council.

pension.note: 2,500 U (the needs-based retiree basket of v64) + 50 U per year worked beyond 20 years, up to 3,750 U; plus the retirement account (up to 120,000 U paid out from retirement); housing guaranteed; health and care free; case-by-case top-ups for disability or high care needs (rule 15).
